content: Furthermore, global mining trends for 2026 heavily underline the strategic importance of technology in driving operational efficiency and enabling agility across volatile supply chains [161] . Sustainability is increasingly taking center stage through circular economy initiatives aimed at reducing waste and improving resource utilization, a paradigm that indirectly but powerfully supports the implementation of green IT frameworks [161] . Collaborative initiatives and international partnerships have also played a vital role in fostering sustainable mining practices. Programs such as the Sweden-Southern Africa Sustainable Mining Grant Program, which continues to operate into 2026, emphasize the integration of sustainability practices across the region [160] . While specific IT solutions are not always explicitly detailed in public summaries of these programs, it is highly probable that digital tracking, energy-efficient hardware, and data analytics form core components of the funding proposals aligned with these sustainable objectives [160] .
